title: client.button
description: The student pressed the button equivalent of a voice command (ADR-0006).

button.description: Button equivalent of an ADR-0006 voice command. Capture is not here: the client takes the photos itself and uploads them with trigger button.

source.description: The source switched to; present exactly when button is switch_source.

reason.description: Since 1.7: why the client paused; allowed only when button is pause. hidden: the page or app went to the background and stops sending (what a pause without reason means too); student: the student put the capture aside in a client still in front of them (the web workspace's Recursos tab), so the backend's idle auto-end keeps the session.

client_time_ms.description: Client clock, Unix epoch ms, when the button was pressed.
